base_candidates_ranked.reason: The IP-MS experiments used a Q-Exactive in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode with MaxQuant for analysis, which typically follows a label-free quantification (LFQ) approach for intensity-based protein identification in pull-downs.

workflow: The Q-Exactive instrument was operated in the data dependent mode to automatically switch between full scan MS and MS/MS acquisition.

differential: Fifty-six mAbs with positive immunoprecipitation using recombinant proteins were subsequently tested by IP-MS using MCF10A-KRAS and MCF10A-empty vector cell lysates.
search_parameters: The search was performed with tryptic enzyme constraint set for up to two missed cleavages, oxidized methionine, phosphorylated serine, threonine, and tyrosine set as variable modifications, and carbamidomethylated cysteine set as a static modification.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The dataset contains multiple assay types, but the PRIDE metadata (PXD012130) specifically refers to the IP-MS (immunoprecipitation-shotgun) experiments. The immuno-MRM data is targeted and handled via Skyline, which is not suitable for standard bottom-up DDA reanalysis pipelines.
